meta_description:
6,997 likes, 153 comments - tonyrobbins on October 14, 2026: "@sagerobbins and I had the privilege of spending last week in Maui with our Platinum family at Platinum Happiness. ☀️🌺 We spent 5 days learning and growing side by side, exploring happiness and everything it touches: our relationships, the way we handle pain, and the expectations we carry. 

We got to see Maui from the air. 🚁🏔️ We took helicopter rides over the island’s mountains, cliffs and ocean, and it was a chance to take in how much beauty and possibility surrounds us when we stop holding so tightly to our expectations of life.

We also spent time with @themauifarm, an organization that provides resources and support for women and families affected by domestic violence. We painted homes for families starting new chapters. We built garden boxes to bring food security to their campus and community. And we helped bring to life a mural of the hāpuʻu fern, a native plant that unfurls new growth even after the hardest seasons. 🎨🌿🤝

What we get in life won’t make us happy long-term. Who we become and what we contribute will, and we felt that here serving The Maui Farm. 🙏

To our Platinum Partners: thank you. Thank you for the energy you brought, the heart you brought, and the love and contribution you poured into others. It’s a true gift to share moments like these with you. 🤟❤️".
